item.title: EplayerX 1.2.38
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 新增飞牛影视服务器接入，支持登录、浏览媒体库和播放。 - 优化画面关键词自动跳过，提高识别效率，完善自定义关键词与正则规则编辑，并增加识别提示。 - 改进 Seerr 多服务器管理、登录和请求列表，优化剧集季选择与请求提交体验。 - 改善 Emby 外挂字幕与播放地址兼容性，优化预告片播放和切换体验。 - 优化提示消息与部分界面文案。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Added FnMedia server support for signing in, browsing libraries, and playback. - Improved the efficiency of on-screen keyword skipping, refined custom keyword and regular-expression editing, and added detection notifications. - Improved Seerr multi-server management, sign-in, and request lists, with refinements to season selection and request submission. - Improved compatibility with Emby external subtitles and playback URLs, and refined trailer playback and switching. - Refined notifications and interface text.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
